reasoning.binding_constraint: Partway into 12% bracket in 29 years: converting more costs more than it saves

cost_of_converting_more.explanation: Converting $1,000 more in 2027 would cost $160 in additional tax: $1,000 in the 12% bracket, plus $40 of state tax.

cost_and_benefit_of_conversions.dollars: today's dollars (the schedule adds up each year's tax as paid)

summary_points.why_this_amount: Fills lower tax brackets during low-income years without pushing into expensive higher brackets
summary_points.how_much_you_save: Estimated $3,786 in lifetime tax savings (in today's dollars)
summary_points.key_tradeoff: Pay tax now at lower rates to avoid higher rates on forced withdrawals in retirement. Converting more enters higher brackets where the cost exceeds the benefit.

sensitivity_notes: Moderate growth assumption (7%) — result changes modestly with ±2% variation
Large income variation across years creates significant conversion opportunities in low-income years
A long plan gives the traditional balance more years to grow, which raises later required withdrawals and the tax on them
Tax on the conversions in 2027 is paid from that year's income, so the whole amount converted stays invested
In 2029 to 2056 the accounts fund spending, so they also pay the tax on the conversions: withdrawals are larger in those years and spending stays the same
RMDs begin at age 75 (15 years from now) — converting before then reduces forced taxable withdrawals in retirement
California income tax adds about 4.0% to conversions (2027); combined federal and state rates are used in optimization
Arizona income tax adds about 2.5% to conversions (2029 to 2056); combined federal and state rates are used in optimization

rmd_summary.explanation: Converting now reduces your future Required Minimum Distributions. Without conversion, RMDs starting at age 75 would peak at $67,060/year. With the recommended conversions, peak RMDs drop to $30,293/year, saving an estimated $18,693 in total RMD taxes over retirement.

assumptions.spending_is: after tax: withdrawals cover it and each year's whole tax bill
assumptions.conversion_tax_paid_from: account withdrawals once the accounts fund spending, income before that
